text.en: Fast R-CNN is listed in the BenchCouncil long-term AI100 table.
text.zh: Fast R-CNN列入 BenchCouncil 长期 AI100 主表。

text.en:
R-CNN achieved strong detection accuracy but ran a convolutional network independently for thousands of proposed regions. Fast R-CNN reorganized the computation so the expensive convolutional backbone was shared across the whole image.

The image is processed once into a feature map, and RoI pooling extracts fixed-size features for each proposal. A single network jointly predicts class probabilities and refined bounding boxes. Experts generally view Fast R-CNN as the key efficiency bridge between R-CNN and fully integrated proposal networks. Its shared features and joint loss became standard design patterns in two-stage detectors.
text.zh:
R-CNN 的检测精度很高，但需要对数千个候选区域分别运行卷积网络。Fast R-CNN 重新组织计算，让昂贵的卷积骨干能够在整张图像上共享。

图像只需处理一次得到特征图，RoI 池化再为每个候选区域提取固定尺寸特征。单个网络联合预测类别概率和修正后的边界框。专家通常把 Fast R-CNN 视为连接 R-CNN 与完整区域候选网络的关键效率桥梁。共享特征和联合损失后来成为两阶段检测器的标准设计。
